description: This file contains the definition of the class 'soapval', which is a PHP class used for representing SOAP value objects with associated XML serialization details. It extends 'nusoap_base' and provides mechanisms for serializing and decoding SOAP values within a SOAP client or server implementation.

classes.name: soapval
classes.description: A class for creating serializable abstractions of native PHP types for SOAP messaging, including element and type names, namespaces, attributes, and value.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a soapval object with optional name, type, value, namespaces, and attributes.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the soapval object into an XML string, suitable for SOAP transmission.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes the soapval object into its PHP native value.
